title: Notice of hearing.
officialText:
A notice of hearing with respect to an order of closure shall be served on the owner and mortgagee of
record of such building or part thereof or such vacant land and on any person alleged to be occupying such building or part thereof or
such vacant land at which the nuisance is located.
